units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 4">Tosef. Yoma IV (III), 14</cite> <he>דְּחָאוֹ ולא מת</he>; Y. ib. VI, 43ᵃ bot. <he>דְּחָייוֹ</he> if the man thrust the goat down the precipice, and it did not die.
Snh. 107ᵇ, a. e. תהא שמאל דּוֹחָה וכ׳ let the left hand repel them and the right invite; a. fr.—Transf. ד׳ בקש, or בקנה to dismiss with a vague or paltry reply.
<cite ref="Chullin 27b">Ḥull. 27ᵇ</cite>. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 8; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 3:4">Tosef. Dem. III, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 31a">Bekh. 31ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:3:7">Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="H00121"><he>חֲבֵירוּת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to suspend, make inoperative, supersede. Ohol. VII, 6 אין דּוֹחִין נפש מפני וכ׳ we dare not set aside the regard due to one human life for the sake of saving another human life; Gen. R. s. 94 כך עושין דוחים וכ׳ is it thus one must act? dare you sacrifice one life &c.?—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:8:2">Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᶜ</cite> top <he>ד׳ את הספק</he> to disregard the doubt the benefit of which is to be given to the criminal.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:1:2">Y. Shek. IV, 47ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>דָּחִינוּ אותו וכ׳</he> we postponed it (the fast) to the first day of the week; <cite ref="Megillah 5b:2">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>דְחִינוּהוּ</he>; <cite ref="Eruvin 41a">Erub. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>דְחִינֻהוּ</he>.—
Pes. VI, 1 אלו דברים … דוחין וכ׳ the following performances needed for the Passover offering take precedence of the Sabbath (cause a suspension of the Sabbath laws); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. דָּחוּי
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:6">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מיתה דְחוּיָה</he> a hurried death.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Yoma 7b">Yoma 7ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>טומאה דְּחוּיָה היא וכ׳</he> the law about levitical purity is only suspended for the sake of an entire community (and its suspension requires atonement), opp. <he>טומאה הותרה</he> the law &c. is inoperative.

<cite ref="Zevachim 12a:10">Zeb. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ מעיקרו</he> unfit from the start, opp. <he>נראה ונדחה</he>, v. infra.—[<cite ref="Yevamot 80b">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 57a">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="D00226"><he>דוחה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="D00495"><he>דִּיהַּ</he></cite>.]
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be pushed aside, suspended; to give way.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 5b:2">Meg. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>הואיל ונ׳ יִדָּחֶה</he> the fast being once suspended (on account of the Sabbath), let it remain so (and not be taken up on Sunday).

<cite ref="Pesachim 66b:11">Pes. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>איש נ׳ … ואין צבור נִידָּחִין</he> an individual (if unclean on Passover) is suspended (postpones the celebration) until the second Passover (<cite ref="Numbers 9:10">Num. IX, 10</cite> sq.), but not a community.

<cite ref="Yoma 64a:5">Yoma 64ᵃ</cite> <he>בעלי חיים אינן נידחין</he> animals (dedicated for sacrifices) cannot be removed forever from sacred use (as long as the obstacle lies not in their physical unfitness).
<cite ref="Yoma 64a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>נראה ונ׳</he> once fit and then discarded (on account of a temporary unfitness).—

<cite ref="Berakhot 64a">Ber. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הנ׳ … שעה נִדֶּחֶת מפניו</he> to him who gives way to time (yielding patiently to circumstances), time will give way, v. <cite ref="D00434"><he>דָּחַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 22a:13">M. Kat. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מדְחֶה מיטתו</he> he who is anxious to remove the bier of a relative (hurries the burial).

<cite ref="Arakhin 30b:46">Arakh. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>אַדְחֶה אבן אחר וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>אידחה</he>, corrupt. of <he>אֲיַדֶּה</he>; Ar. <he>דְּחֵה</he> imperat. Kal) I will throw a stone after the fallen man (not give the sinner a chance to return). [<cite ref="Nazir 16b">Naz. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>מדחין בה</he> Ar., read with ed. <he>כדהוינן בה</he>.] [<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 8:8">Tosef. Toh. VIII, 8</cite> <he>המדחה</he>, v. <cite ref="J00301"><he>יָּחַס</he></cite>.]
